description:
v1.0 | 8 gates | 3 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

2 bits in, 4 lines out: only the line of the current value is on.

Use this to pick one item out of many by number, such as choosing which memory cell to read or lighting one lamp out of a grid of lamps.

Feed the number into the inputs, with the lowest value input first. Exactly one output turns on, the one whose number matches the inputs, and all other outputs stay off. Connect each output to the target for its number.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): the value = x 0-1.
Outputs (green gates): line k = x k.

Profile: fast, the build with the fewest ticks for this size.
How it works: One wide gate per term: gates take any number of inputs, so no stages are needed.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.

Other sizes, the generator and the full explanation:
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits/tree/main/circuits/decoder
